thread:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — production canary errors for model v4b detected. 5xx spike and tokenization failures. auto-alert threshold breached (5m error rate > 4%).
jamie (oncall): I'm on it. linking logs and canary dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/canaries/v4b
sophia (infra): I see the same — canary nodes return lots of `illegal token` parsing errors, and inference pods show KV cache mismatches in logs. attaching snippet:
```
ERROR 11:08:22 shard[12] expected weights dim 4096 got 4095
KVCache: incompatibility detected, dropping session
```
carlos (ml): that looks like a shard alignment issue. recent rollout used shard-reindex script `upload_weights.sh` — possible off-by-one index when generating tarball. canary traces show top-n perplexity jumped x3.
maria (prod): any customer impact yet? finance reported 3 paying customers saw truncated responses in the last 10m. ticket count up 40%.
evan (support): I'm triaging tickets and sending canned status. Customers asked if their prompts were corrupted.
jamie (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) stop rollout (kill switch), 2) pin canary to previous model v4a, 3) scale canary down if needed, 4) open incident call if rollback doesn't stabilize. assigning tasks.
sophia (infra): I'm toggling the feature flag for rollout gating now: `rbac:feature_rollouts.v4b_enable=false`
deploy-bot: feature flag `feature_rollouts.v4b_enable` set to `false` by sophia at 11:11 UTC :white_check_mark:
jamie (oncall): confirm we also want to disable the automated weight autoupdate job? (`weights-autoupdate-cron`).
carlos (ml): yes, pause the cron. pausing now.
deploy-bot: cronjob `weights-autoupdate` suspended at 11:12 UTC
sophia (infra): initiating canary pin to v4a for affected hosts. command: 
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/pin -d '{"model":"redwood/v4a","scope":"canary"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****'
```
jamie (oncall): doing the pin. watching logs.
deploy-bot: pin request accepted, starting rollout of v4a to canary nodes
ops-bot: Update — latency normalizing, 5xx rate dropping. current canary error rate 0.6% (was 5.2%).
carlos (ml): quick root cause hypothesis: weight bundle generation script used zero-based shard ids but packaging step incremented index, causing shard 0 -> shard 1 mapping shift. weights off-by-one leads to shape mismatch at load time. model loads but KV mapping mismatched -> tokenization and runtime errors.
maria (prod): estimate of impact: about 4% of requests during 11:02–11:12 UTC saw quality or truncation issues. no data exfiltration. customers with long-context chats most affected. notifying account execs.
evan (support): posting updated status to status.redwood: "Partial degradation for some v4b canaries — rollback to v4a in progress. We will follow up."
jamie (oncall): oncall handoff: current oncall (jamie) remains until stabilization. @sophia start shadow oncall. if stable for 30m, we'll hand back.
sophia (infra): monitoring autoscaling: canary count reduced from 12->6 to limit blast radius.
carlos (ml): collecting packages: please upload the v4b weights bundle to /incidents/1967804321/artifacts for postmortem. include `manifest.json` and `upload.log`.
jamie (oncall): created incident channel #incident-1967804321 for the bridge and customer comms. invite list: @maria @carlos @sophia @evan @eng-oncall.
maria (prod): starting customer comms: draft message ready for key customers, will wait for final numbers.
ops-bot: Alert — canary metrics stable for 4m, automatic rollback success rate: 100% on pinned nodes. No new 5xx.
jamie (oncall): closing immediate pager loop but leaving incident open for RCA. action items: (A) verify weight upload pipeline, add unit test to detect shard-index mismatch; (B) add preflight `manifest` checksum and shape validation in control-plane; (C) run canary smoke test that loads model and validates tokenization on a synthetic prompt before enabling rollout.
carlos (ml): I'll own A and C, target PRs by EOD.
sophia (infra): I'll own B and disable autoupdate permanently until we have checksum validation, ETA tomorrow morning.
evan (support): I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and compile ticket list.
maria (prod): schedule postmortem with exec summary and impact numbers.
jamie (oncall): final checks: confirm deploy-bot shows no pending v4b shards.
deploy-bot: all pending v4b deploys cancelled at 11:28 UTC.
jamie (oncall): thanks team. incident status: mitigated -> rollback complete -> monitoring. will file follow-up incident doc and postmortem. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident recorded: 1967804321 — severity: P2, root cause suspected off-by-one shard in weights packaging.
